svg.title: BearAgent runtime architecture
svg.desc: A layered view of BearAgent interfaces, application and runtime, authority and execution, ports and adapters, and durable data and evidence. Every component is marked with its implementation phase.

g.text: Local-first · durable by design · authority stays outside the model
Phase tags show when each capability enters the project.
stream progress and inspect execution facts

svg.text: Accepted target architecture · current implementation remains intentionally small
